description: This file contains a class LoadSheddingValidator that implements the IConfigurationValidator interface. It validates the LoadSheddingOptions configuration by checking if load shedding is enabled and if the CPU and Memory thresholds are within valid ranges.

classes.name: LoadSheddingValidator
classes.description: A validator class for LoadSheddingOptions configuration, ensuring CPU and Memory thresholds are within valid ranges.

methods.name: ValidateConfiguration
methods.description: Validates the load shedding configuration options, throwing exceptions if thresholds are outside valid bounds.
